title: Mixed Event — A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?!

meta.Event: A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?!
meta.Outline: Not long before White Day, Tsukasa is set to perform as an extra at a facility where visitors can make their own chocolates. Meanwhile, Mizuki has come up with plans for White Day return gifts, and invites Akito along for some chocolate making.

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Great work today, everyone!
Let's do the same tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah! See you then!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Building that huge prop today was so much fun! I can't wait to show Miku and... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & KAITO
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hm?
Tsukasa and KAITO seem really worried about something. What could be bothering them so much?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey!
Everything okay, you guys?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, Len, I take it you're done working on that prop? Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The plushies and I had a lot of fun with that! But more importantly, is something wrong? You guys seem pretty concerned about something.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, I was just asking Tsukasa about this...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Asking him about what...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: About... White Day!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: White Day?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. For Valentine's Day, Saki, Emu and the others presented me with such spectacular cakes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why I'll need to give something extra special in return for White Day!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
That sounds like something a star who can make everyone smile like you should do!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, exactly!
But the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm not sure what to get...
I've tried so hard, but I'm not getting any good ideas...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're kidding, right? You're Tsukasa Tenma! Just give her a show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, that's already in the works!
I'll be inviting Emu and the others to my house for that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I also want to surprise them with something that's truly special besides just a show! Something that'll really move them!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Something special other than a show, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. Their Valentine's Day presents must've been really something if you're getting this worked up about it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I have to agree.
Why don't we keep trying to think of something truly special for just a little bit longer...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I'll help too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You will?! Thank you, Len, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, let's get right to it...
Besides a show, what would make a good gift?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hmm... Well...
What about sweets or flowers?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I already suggested those things, but Tsukasa seems to want something more special or grandiose.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What would really wow Saki, Emu and the others...? Hmm... They're usually happy about any gifts they receive, which actually makes this even harder...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, what if you surprised them somehow during your show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
During the show?
How?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As it happens, we'll also be surprising Miku and the others with a show...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The story involves us building a gingerbread house, and we'll be inviting all of them into that house as a surprise at the end.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow! That sounds incredible!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. And just today, the plushies and I were working on that very house! But that's just between us, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Roger!
Still...
A surprise within a show...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If a surprise proves too challenging, you can always present everyone with a gift through your show. For example, we'll be giving each of our guests their own gingerbread house.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...!
That's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our show will be a spin-off of Pegasus Odyssey where the prince goes on a quest to search for Pegasus... A surprise involving that would be...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, I know...!
What if I appeared before Saki and everyone else during the final scene as a shining Pegasus?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Having to also play Pegasus off the cuff may prove a bit difficult...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, what if you presented them with the sword from Pegasus Odyssey at the end?! That thing's so cool because it looks real!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... Emu would certainly enjoy that, but I'm not sure Saki would...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's true... Alright, what if my quest took me to a field of a thousand roses...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... We've come up with plenty of ideas, but none of them seem like the right answer...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, trying to please everyone is no easy task.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed... However, you both gave me the idea of presenting a gift related to our show, so I need to thank you for that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'll have to leave this for another day. I should get going soon...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What? You're leaving already?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I have a gig this weekend and need to remain in good condition for it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A gig?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Rui mentioned before that you work as an extra sometimes while your stage undergoes maintenance and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it's work that's reserved for those with acting experience! That even includes some opportunities to be a full-cast member instead of just an extra!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds interesting.
What will you be doing this weekend?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll be performing at the “Chocolate Factory” that just recently opened!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
The Chocolate Factory...?
As in an actual factory for making chocolate?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You're performing at a factory?
That seems kinda strange.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, after doing some research, I found that it's also partly a museum.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A place where people can learn about the history of chocolate, compare different kinds of chocolate and even make their own tasty treats!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! That sounds super fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But what does a show there involve?
Mind telling us more after you're finished with your performance?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll be off.
Thank you both again for your advice! I'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We talked a lot and came up with some ideas, but none of them really seemed to work.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How can we help Tsukasa? Isn't there a good idea out there that he can use...?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(White Day's coming up soon.
What should I get for Saki and the others?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Considering Saki went through the trouble of baking that incredible chocolate cake for us, I'd like to get her something special in return...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I'll try looking online.
White Day gifts... Oh, here we go.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (An assortment of baked goods... That'd be nice since we could all share them, and Saki would probably love these macarons.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh, cookies with messages written on them might work too. I could have a lot of fun with that.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (What else is there...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “Make your very own chocolates at the Chocolate Factory!”...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(What is this place?
They have all these chocolates that look like animals and musical instruments...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (So you can really make chocolates in all shapes and sizes here...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (“Why not make something unique this year for that special someone using your own two hands?”)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Interesting. This might be the answer. Also, I'd like to surprise everyone somehow by...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hey, Kiritani.
About to have lunch...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I thought that it'd be nice to eat in the courtyard for a change and was just waiting for Minori. Will you be eating with Tenma and the others?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Tenma and Hoshino may be another minute since our teacher had to talk to them about something.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's fine.
Thanks for letting me know.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is that the site for the Chocolate Factory?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?! Uhh...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry, it just happened to catch my eye. I was browsing through that site just earlier today...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, you too?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I mean, look how cute these penguin chocolates are. I kind of want to try making my own now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
They're so adorably chubby...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I knew you'd like them too, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi and the others gave me something really special during Valentine's Day, so I'm hoping to do the same for them this White Day.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Something special...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. That's why I believe making something unique, such as making my own chocolates, would be the best way to show my appreciation for them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I see your point...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hey...
Why don't we go together, Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, are you sure?
I was under the impression that you wanted to go with Tenma and the others...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I want to surprise them with a gift too.
I feel like I should give back for a change after being given so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's so nice of you.
Alright, let's go together. This should be fun.
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whew... I'm stuffed...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Alright, now what?
Toya's on library duty today, so I guess this is my chance to sneak in a quick nap...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh! Hey, Li'l Bro!
How ya been?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No rest for the wicked, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm? What was that?
You say something?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Don't mind that last part.
Also, fancy seeing you at school like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I felt like being a good student today♪ Oh, Li'l Bro, more importantly...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Do you like chocolate...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Chocolate?
What's this really about...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'll get to that in a minute.
You like pancakes, right? That's why I'm asking whether or not you like chocolate. So, do you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean, sure...
As long as they're good.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Awesome! That's what I wanted to hear!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As it so happens, this place called the Chocolate Factory where you can make your own chocolates just opened up recently!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Everyone's been talking online about how you can make these super adorable creations, so I kinda want to take a stab at it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sadly, Ena and An both said they were busy this weekend when I tried to invite them, but I still really want to go...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is where you come in, Li'l Bro. If you like chocolate, we could go together, and invite Toya too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No way. Sweets aren't really Toya's thing.
Also, can't you just ask Ena or An to go next week?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, Li'l Bro, I knew you'd say that...
Luckily, I've got a little scoop for you! Check this out!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm...?
“Famed chocolatier, Paul Hansen, will be making a special appearance at the Chocolate Factory”...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Paul Hansen...?
As in the guy with shops all over the world?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, him!
He's gonna be at the Chocolate Factory this weekend!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And by being there during his chocolate-baking demonstration, you'll get a chance to buy his latest creations before anyone else!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: His latest creation...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup!
From what I've heard, they're supposed to be out of this world!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I see...
That raises the stakes a bit...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, no. You're going anyway, so I could just have you buy some for me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Swing and a miss! Each person's limited to just one purchase! Also, Ena said the exact same thing... Talk about blood being thicker than water...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Ugh... Seriously...?
I can't believe I fell into the same trap as her...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, wanna come with?
It'll be a chance for you to make and buy delicious chocolates!
Weekend
Chocolate Factory - Green Room

rows.Speaker: Guide
rows.Line:
And here's the green room.
The one in charge of this event will be with you shortly to explain how things will proceed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wonderful!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Despite coming in through the employee entrance, you can smell what's going on in the Chocolate Factory even from the green room.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Looks like I'll be working with some other cast members as well... Oh, that must be whoever's in charge...)

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
We're so glad that you were all able to join us today.

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: Before we get started, I'd like to give you all a quick rundown of the Chocolate Factory's mission statement.

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: “Bring smiles to all through chocolate.” That's our goal for this establishment.

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: We're hoping that our guests can learn more about chocolate and even make some themselves while having fun in the process.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I see...
We try to make people smile through our shows, but this place is attempting to do so using chocolate instead.)

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: Your objective will be to provide a fun and enjoyable atmosphere for our guests as they immerse themselves into the world of chocolate. This will include putting on a small show.

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: At the entrance, we will be asking you to play our company's mascot, Chocota, by wearing his costume.

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: In addition, we will need you to convey the information regarding the history of chocolate presented in the “Education Zone” through brief skits or interpretive acts...
<Oh no...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Did my phone flash just now...?
Also, that sounded like Len's voice...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, I must've imagined that...
Right now, I need to focus on this lecture!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(That was close...!
I forgot that Tsukasa's supposed to be working today.)

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: Next, I'd like to show where you'll all be performing, as well as what exactly you'll be doing...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Oh, are they having a discussion about the show they're gonna be doing today...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(But what kind of show?
I think I'll stick around for a quick listen!)
Chocolate Factory - Green Room

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: Next... Tenma and Hamano.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Present!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: H-Here.

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: We'll be having both of you perform in the show for our guests as they prepare their own chocolates.

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: There will be a period when everyone will have to wait for their chocolates to cool.

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: During that time, you'll be making your appearance and putting on a show for them. In terms of what you'll be performing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I see. It seems fairly straightforward.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The chocolate-loving “Choco Maniac” will be appearing alongside the mascot, “Chocota” the chocolate fairy, to start things off...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The Choco Maniac catches a glimpse of the chocolates that the guests are making and feels compelled to steal them because “they look so delicious.”)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But Chocota steps in to stop that from happening by saying, “They worked so hard to make these! They're not for you to take!”)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In that moment, Chocota asks everyone about who they're making these chocolates for, as well as why...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The Choco Maniac is so moved by their words that he has no choice but to withdraw.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Also, the script's very short... Only two to three pages... However, we'll have to ad-lib as we interact with each guest.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That just leaves who'll be playing the Choco Maniac and Chocota... But my fellow cast member and I should be able to work that out.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to working with you today, Hamano!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
Yes, likewise.
Let's make the most of today, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They said that we could choose amongst ourselves which roles to play, so which would you like?

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: Um... I don't mind either way.

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: I'm just a part-timer with only some acting experience, but I've had opportunities to play both roles for this since this place opened...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I see... He appears to be a few years older than me, so maybe I can lean on his experience.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Understood!
Then, would it be alright if I played the Choco Maniac...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our friend here may be a bar of chocolate, but I can't say that I'm very used to acting while donning a mascot's costume...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
That's understandable.
I promise to do my best as Chocota.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Alright, we should do a table-read and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hamano...?

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I haven't been feeling that great today... I'd like to go outside to get some fresh air...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Is he gonna be okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm not sure.
His face was flushed and... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wah!
L-Len?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Shh!
Tsukasa, keep it down!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
Still, what are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You're undecided about what to do for White Day, right? I was hoping that I could help you somehow...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Then I heard you guys talking about this show you're about to do and decided to listen in!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
I appreciate the concern.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<No problem!
More importantly, your friend there really didn't seem well...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I agree. He may be in rougher shape than we realize... I'll try asking him after he gets back and we start practicing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay!>
Chocolate Factory

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Did you all enjoy the opening number?
From here, you'll all be plunging headfirst into the world of chocolate!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A show right off the bat...
I really wasn't expecting anything like this from the start.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I knew that this place is supposed to partly be a museum, but that was a nice surprise.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Bring smiles to all through chocolate.” That really hit home with me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's do our best today to make sure our chocolates put a smile on everyone's faces.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Speaking of which, what kind of chocolates do you plan on making today, Hinomori? They're for Tenma and your other friends, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm gonna try to make some look like shooting stars for my bandmates... Also, some rabbits.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Shooting stars...?
Oh, because Leo/need comes from the Leonid meteor shower?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's really nice.
But who are the rabbits for?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Oh... My classmates... And myself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
K-Kiritani, how about you?
What do you plan on making?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm thinking about some clovers as a return gift, and some penguins for myself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Penguins...
You really can't get enough of them, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I really can't.
Anyway, let's make the cutest creations we can.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Man, that was so much fun!
I wasn't expecting to see a show like that in a place like this!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Same. I was worried that a certain someone would be making a surprise appearance...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get to making our chocolates.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? You're excited about making chocolates, Li'l Bro? I thought you were all about seeing Paul Hansen today...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, I want to make something good if possible.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. That's true too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way, do you know what you're gonna make? I for one plan on making some really adorable stuff♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No. At least, not yet...
I don't really care how they look as long as they taste good, you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, we have a ton of toppings to choose from... Nuts are pretty standard, but orange zest could be a nice touch...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, these look amazing!
Can I have one once you're done♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? No way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aww, come on! Not even a little nibble?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Quit bugging me and focus on your own stuff. It's not like we get to be here forever.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, you're right!
I'll start with... A bow!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
You've all been doing great so far!
Next, we'll start decorating our creations!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: You have quite a bit to choose from, so feel free to use all the toppings you like!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(What can I use for my rabbits' eyes...?
The pink chocolate pen could work, but we have all these toppings at our disposal so...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Oh, they have finely cut dried fruits.
These raspberries might be what I'm looking for.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (As for the shooting stars, I'll draw the tails using the chocolate pens and throw in some silver dragees to make them twinkle...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I could also use the chocolate pens to write everyone's names... And...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hinomori's decorating her chocolates beautifully. She must really want to give her friends something they'll like...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which means I should do the same.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Minori's clover is milk chocolate so I'll use the pink pen, and a white pen for Airi's since hers is strawberry flavored.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Shizuku's uses white chocolate, so a brown pen should do nicely.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. I hope they like these...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, they have pink dragees! These are so cute! They'll be perfect for my bow's knot!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki

rows.Line: I agree. We'd be able to buy some time, but our show would fall apart in the process. I suppose some simple hearts will just have to do...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, wait. Chocota's this place's mascot. There must be molds of him lying around... Found one!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, good call!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright... Ahem!

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “He's always there to stop me from eating any chocolate, which has led to us fighting and bickering each time we've met...”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “But he's put these delicious treats into a new light for me. For that, I must show him my appreciation.”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Which is why I'd like to make some chocolates that look just like Chocota as a sort of olive branch!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “That's a great idea, Mr. Thief!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Thank you!
So let's start making our chocolate Chocotas!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Alright, everyone, remember what we need to do after we choose a design?”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: “Melt the chocolate!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Once that's all melted, we just need to pour it into the molds, wait for them to cool and decorate them with some toppings...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But we can't keep this up forever. Will Akito and Chocota be able to make it back in time...?)

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: Okay, the other show proceeded as planned, which means the demo corner should also be...

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Wait, is that...?
Green Room

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Feel better?

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
I don't think we've met, but thank you. So, who are you...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I'm the Choco Maniac's... Acquaintance...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
I see...
I've become such a burden for Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Nah, don't worry about him.
He's not the kind of guy who gets mad over something like this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: More importantly, you think you can go back out there? He sort of wants to end everything with all of us out there, so if you think you can make it...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
Yes, I should...
Hnng...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
No... It's just...
My heart's been throbbing nonstop...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry...
It should settle down in a minute...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (There's definitely something weighing on Hamano's mind, but he wants this show to go on despite that...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did something happen by chance...?

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You sounded like you were in pain while crying, and yet, you still want to see this show through...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which is why I'm asking if something not so great happened to you?

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: It has to do with a childhood friend...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: I'd known this girl who lived next door since we were both little, and we used to play a lot together.

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: She even suggested that I try performing in these shows part-time because of my interest in acting. And so, I did...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
She's also quite the confectioner...
I've received many delicious gifts from her on Valentine's Day and I made sure to give something back each year... Until this past year...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: When she got married and moved overseas...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: We were close enough that I knew she was dating someone from abroad, which didn't actually bother me that much...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Me...? They're for my friend, Haru, who lives next door to me!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: She always gives me snacks and sweets for Valentine's Day, so I want to give something back for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: And I want to keep doing this for Haru until I'm old and gray!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
But what that boy said...
That sort of did it for me...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
I saw myself in him...
I realized that I was hoping that I'd be able to keep giving her gifts until the day I died...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I see...
Now it all makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: Again, I apologize for causing such a stir. I don't deserve to play this role anymore...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
But I want to go back out there.
Tenma's still trying to keep this show going, so I should be out there to help him do that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(He's still crying...
And his face is still flushed...)

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
I'll put this costume back on and...
Wah...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, watch out...!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
Oww...
I'm sorry. I think I got up too quickly and... Are you alright?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'm fine...
But I really don't think you're in any shape to go back out there.

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: No, I can't just quit because of something like this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, you've clearly been through a great deal...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: But what kind of actor would I be by bringing my baggage on stage...?

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: That girl's the one who originally said that I should go into acting. She said that I have a talent for making people smile...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm no actor, but I know how you feel since I also have some experience performing on stage...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you can't just cut yourself off from what you're feeling. I've learned that there are times when you just can't do anything...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have no idea if this is going to help, but this is what I had to go through...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You'll be able to sing the way you want as long as you have your friends by your side.

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: Friends...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
In this case, it's the Choco Maniac.
He's been worried sick about you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He even wants you to be smiling when this is all said and done.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So if you do plan on going back out there, I think you should rely on him more. That might be your best way out of this situation.

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: Hamano!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line:
Why aren't you out there performing?!
Did something happen?!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: Oh, that's because...

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line: Also, there's someone else trying to lead everyone around... If something had happened, we'll need to stop this show at once before...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (C-Crap...!)

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: Please, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: I made a mistake during the show and am having Tenma cover for me right now.

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: But I promise to see this through to the end. I promise to make everyone smile...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Good.
That's the spirit, Chocota.
Chocolate Factory

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Alright, the chocolates have finally cooled. Now for decorations!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
“Yeah!
How do you want to decorate them, Mr. Thief?”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Hmm... These chocolates will need to look so gorgeous that our crybaby friend won't have any choice but to turn his frown upside down!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
“Yeah, that'd be awesome!
We can make them all shiny and sparkly♪”

rows.Line:
(Looks like everyone's having fun!
But...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Our chocolates will be done soon...
Which also means...)

rows.Line: These special refrigerators are supposed to help dry everything we made faster, right?

rows.Line: (I'd say we have five minutes at most...)

rows.Line: (Maybe it's too late for Hamano to reappear...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
...
Hey!

rows.Line:
Tsukasa!

rows.Line:
What...?!
Does that mean Hamano's ready...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's regroup and get ready for the finale!

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Just sprinkle on a few more of these sparkly bits... Slowly... Little by little and... Done!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Now to hand what we've made to Chocota...”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's your signal. Ready?

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
“Hey!
Chocota says he's all better now!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “I'm back, everyone!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Huh?
Hey, it's him!

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line:
“Sorry for causing such a fuss earlier!
I really didn't mean to surprise you like that, Choco Maniac...”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Yes, you really had me going there!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“But you seem much better now!
I'd expect no less from my respected rival!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “Hehe. Luckily, I had my friend over there to help cheer me up!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“That's great to hear!
Thank you, we appreciate what you've done!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
“You're welcome...!
It didn't seem right to see Chocota crying like that!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
“Anyway, Mr. Thief...!
I believe it's time to present Chocota with his gift♪”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “What?”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Yes, that's right!
Here... This is for you!!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “For me?! But you're the Choco Maniac. I thought you only stole chocolate from people. You really made these for me...?!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Because you were crying!
Honestly, we were worried sick about you.”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “So, we all worked together to make these, including the little ones. They were just as concerned about you.”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “Choco Maniac... All of you...”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “The truth is, a close friend with whom I've been exchanging Valentine's Day gifts will be moving away soon...”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “I was reminded of that earlier and was overwhelmed with sadness. However...”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “The chocolates you all made with the Choco Maniac have helped put a smile back on my face! Thank you!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “I don't like having to say goodbye to such a close friend, but it's great to know that I'll have plenty of opportunities in the future to meet new friends, like you!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Chocota...”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “But your friend won't be gone forever. You'll always have a connection to each other...”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “So you should keep exchanging gifts!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line:
“You're right...!
Thanks, Choco Maniac!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: That's great, Chocota!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Make sure to eat lots and lots of the chocolates we made for you, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“And there you have it..!
Because of all of you, I know how joyous it is to give someone else chocolates! Thank you!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “I vow to no longer steal anyone's chocolates, and become Choco Maniac the great chocolatier!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line:
“What?!
Well, someone's in a good mood... Hehe.”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Hah hah hah!!
We shall meet again when you come back to make chocolates! Until then, farewell!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “Bye!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: “Bye bye!!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(They're all smiles...!
Great job, Tsukasa!)

rows.Line: We did it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Ad-libbing for that long during the show is quite an accomplishment if I do say so myself...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No kidding...
I'd be tripping over what to say even for just one line.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Really?

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hamano!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: I'm so sorry about what happened today. This show would've gone so much smoother if it weren't for me...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
But you were all willing to help.
You made this show a fun and happy occasion for all. How do I even begin to thank you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
There's no need for that!
After all, you gave us the smile we were hoping to see in the end! I couldn't be happier as a future star!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: Future star?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! My name is Tsukasa Tenma, the bright star of the future! Behold my acting prowess!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
I won't forget your name!
I'm sure you'll achieve your dream!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As for you two... Thank you for jumping in to help us like that. We really appreciate what you did today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There was no way we could've sent everyone home smiling without you both, so bravo!

rows.Speaker: Staff's Voice
rows.Line:
Everyone!
The chocolates are all finished!

rows.Speaker: Staff's Voice
rows.Line: We'll be handing them out one at a time, so we ask you to please be patient while we do!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, the chocolates are done!
We should make sure to go get some later.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's give everyone else a chance to get theirs first before we go...

rows.Line:
Hm? That must be the staff.
Come in...!

rows.Line: Excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I came here with a friend today to make chocolates for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're here with a friend?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Haruka!

rows.Line: Hello. Pardon the intrusion.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, we met at the shrine...!
Hold on, does this mean you were both among the audience today?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you for seeing our show today!
Are you here to greet all the cast members?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We wanted to give you a little gift for all your hard work today... Okay, by “we”, I really mean Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A gift?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, Hinomori and I had made some extra chocolates... Here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa! These are so cute!
They made us a bunch of rabbits and penguins♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, they look good...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
These are magnificent...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know! Sit tight for just one sec!
Lemme get my chocolates so we can all trade!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'll go get mine too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
W-Wait, I don't have anything to give...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think you've given plenty already, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She's right.
You gave us a wonderful show that put a smile on everybody's faces today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, here we are...
Nice work today, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you were awesome out there!
Here's a little something from me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I... I don't know what to say...!
I feel so blessed to have such wonderful juniors...!
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Now you're gonna cry?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
Waahhh!
Why are homemade chocolates so heartwarming?!

rows.Line: (Hehe. There really is something special about homemade chocolates... Oh, wait!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phew... I can finally relax...

rows.Line: We had to deal with quite a lot today, but our show turned out well and the Chocolate Factory was all smiles in the end. However, most importantly...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Nice work today, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Len!

rows.Line: <That's totally fine! Your show was just that amazing♪ Also...>

rows.Line: Oh, okay! Did you already eat yours, Toya?

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: And there's Rui right in the nick of time...! Later, guys! Hey, Rui!

rows.Line: Gone, just like that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.

rows.Line:
Thanks for everything! Here!

rows.Line: But I guess it is a special day, so I'll give Akiyama a pass...

rows.Line: A big, white Pegasus! In chocolate form! It's adorable!!

rows.Line: This looks amazing! It's a horsey, but it's really chocolate! Also, it's almost as big as a birthday cake!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Because... It would've been a pain... I mean, Tsukasa's a better storyteller than me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's our Tsukasa for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! As a future star should!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Of course! Start from wherever you like! There's plenty to go around for everyone!

rows.Line: Thanks, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:

rows.Line:

Ready?
